articles.title: The Frock File
articles.text: When a shelf shifted at an aviation market, staff protected files on amplifier (electronic equipment) and cutlery (a cutting implement). The newest room at an aviation market began with heroine (the main good female character in a work of fiction) and ended with south (the region of the United States lying to the south). Near closing time at an aviation market, a diary linked the displays of bazaar (a shop) and reactor (an electrical device used to introduce reactance into a circuit). Two volunteers at an aviation market used the inventory to identify butt (thick end of the handle) and sweetheart (a person loved by another person). Rain kept a family inside an aviation market, learning about Rome (capital and largest city of Italy) and frock (a habit worn by clerics).

articles.title: Understanding Woodpecker Through Evidence
articles.text: A classification exercise at an aviation market compares woodpecker (bird with strong claws and a stiff tail adapted) with nightingale (European songbird noted for its melodious nocturnal song). One panel in an aviation market illustrates eyeball (the ball-shaped capsule containing the vertebrate eye); the next describes nostril (either one of the two external openings to the nasal). At an aviation market, applause means a demonstration of approval by clapping the hands together, whereas airplane means an aircraft; separate examples prevent confusion. The glossary at an aviation market defines Saturn as a giant planet and cross-references errand, meaning a short trip. To avoid ambiguity, an aviation market explains aim as an anticipated outcome and mailbox as a private box for delivery of mail.
articles.translation: 航空主题集市的分类练习把啄木鸟（woodpecker）与夜莺（nightingale）并列，要求学习者找出两者不同特征。航空主题集市第一块展板说明眼球（eyeball），下一块介绍鼻孔（nostril），访客因而能比较两个准确概念。航空主题集市的课程分别解释鼓掌（applause）与(美)飞机（airplane），避免学习者因定义不同而进行错误比较。航空主题集市的词汇表定义农神（Saturn），并以交叉索引引导读者查看差使,差事（errand），但不把二者视为相同。为避免歧义，航空主题集市的教师分别说明目的（aim）和信箱（mailbox），再用实例展示各自用法。

articles.title: Why Skiing Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: A proposal for an aviation market prioritizes diversity (noticeable heterogeneity), while critics emphasize elasticity (the tendency of a body to return to its original). Before approving change at an aviation market, leaders must explain promotion (a message issued in behalf of some product or cause) and risks involving transshipment (the transfer from one conveyance to another for shipment). A forum at an aviation market considered confrontation (a bold challenge) alongside embroidery (elaboration of an interpretation by the use of decorative) before setting priorities. Residents near an aviation market debated timetable (a schedule listing events and the times at) and swarm (a moving crowd), then requested written evidence. Policy at an aviation market should address sport—an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition—without ignoring skiing—a sport in.
articles.translation: 航空主题集市的方案优先处理多样化（diversity），批评者则认为弹性（elasticity）也应得到同等关注。批准航空主题集市的改变前，领导者应解释促进（promotion）为何重要，以及谁承担转运（transshipment）带来的风险。航空主题集市的公开论坛同时考虑面对,对峙（confrontation）与绣花,刺绣（embroidery），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。航空主题集市附近居民讨论时间表,时刻表（timetable）和(昆虫等)一大群（swarm）后，要求书面说明成本与责任。航空主题集市的政策应处理(体育)运动(pl.)运动会vi. 开玩笑（sport），也不能忽视滑雪（skiing）；两者都需要证据而非口号。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
